Problem: 50 µL tip definition works locally but fails pickup and positioning on another machine.
Systems / context: Hamilton 50 µL tips/racks represented in PyLabRobot
Resolution / reusable lesson: Correct tip length, z position, and rack parameters; document the multi-cause diagnosis and merge fixes.
Public artifact: Forum post-mortem and merged PyLabRobot corrections
Known limitation: Does not validate all machines, lots, or tip families.

Problem: VENUS 4 COM-based control no longer works after upgrading to VENUS 6.
Resolution / reusable lesson: Use the VENUS 6 REST API and enable the API server; treat legacy COM guidance as version-specific.
Public artifact: Public forum explanation and API activation instructions
Known limitation: API coverage, licensing, and future compatibility remain version-bound.

Problem: Source control captures a live Fluent recovery workspace and restored files are overwritten.
Systems / context: Tecan Fluent Git workflow and active runtime state
Resolution / reusable lesson: Exclude active recovery/runtime workspaces from ordinary source control; distinguish method source, deployment configuration, and transient state.
Known limitation: A complete vendor-independent deployment manifest is not supplied.

Problem: Composite liquid-transfer operation fails only after pickup and aspiration.
Systems / context: PyLabRobot composite transfer with destination lid assigned
Resolution / reusable lesson: Validate the complete operation sequence and modeled destination state before dispatch; record material in transit and final disposition after failure.
Public artifact: Forum design discussion and queued-validation proposal
Known limitation: Implementation and scientific recovery outcome are not confirmed.

Problem: Users cannot find Hamilton HSL documentation despite installed reference material.
Resolution / reusable lesson: Use the editor help/reference and bundled examples; distinguish built-in reference access from paid training and source-file review.
Known limitation: Reference completeness and current-version coverage are not assessed.

Problem: A scheduling toy problem cannot be evaluated because scientific and operating constraints are missing.
Resolution / reusable lesson: Specify stability windows, interruptibility, terminal disposition, priorities, storage eligibility, and failure policy before comparing schedules.
Public artifact: Public toy problem and constraint-elicitation discussion
Known limitation: The thread does not produce a fully resolved benchmark instance.

Problem: A Tecan driver exists but cannot be used without Driver Framework licensing.
Resolution / reusable lesson: Verify licence availability separately from driver installation; consider an external RS-232 wrapper and plan state synchronization explicitly.
Known limitation: Price estimates are unofficial; external control may not update internal platform state.

Problem: Pressure curves differ between aspiration cycles and are treated as possible transfer failures.
Resolution / reusable lesson: Record starting volume, tip reuse, liquid class, aspiration settings, and independent transfer measurement before attributing curve differences to failure.
Known limitation: Curve shape alone does not establish transferred volume or root cause.

Problem: AI-generated HSL methods are described with a 92% success rate.
Resolution / reusable lesson: Describe the result as 92/100 simulation-trace agreement; report dry, wet, assay, artifact-generation, and error-handling evidence separately.
Public artifact: Public test data and trace-comparison description
Known limitation: No independent wet or assay replication is reported.

Problem: Contributors do not know how to update PyLabRobot documentation.
Resolution / reusable lesson: Provide local build commands and a page-level edit path that opens a GitHub contribution flow.
Known limitation: A contribution path does not establish complete documentation coverage.
